verdict.rationale: Parsec documents a Teams API with a docs page for automation and audit logs, so asking for an interactive API reference is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive explorer or runnable examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. The existence of the API and a docs link is adjacent evidence only and does not show the requested interactive reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
